        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

</span>

        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Backfill plan name. if left empty, a string of characters is randomly generated by system.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#datatimeorder_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data<wbr>Time<wbr>Order</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>Backfill Execution Order - The execution order for backfill instances based on their data time. Effective only when both conditions are met:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Must be the same cycle task.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Priority is given to dependency order. If no dependencies apply, execution follows the configured order.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Valid values:</p>
<p>-NORMAL: No specific order (default)</p>
<p>-ORDER: Execute in chronological order</p>
<p>-REVERSE: Execute in reverse chronological order.</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="redefinecycletype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#redefinecycletype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">redefine<wbr>Cycle<wbr>Type</a>
</span>

        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

## Import



WeData data backfill plan can be imported using the projectId#dataBackfillPlanId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Wedata/dataBackfillPlan:DataBackfillPlan example 2430455587205529600#de336ae4-372b-44e5-8659-7027cfb46916
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
